audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side is a templated "Skill" placeholder on all 7 rows, contradicting content win[] (Blitzcrank favored rows 1-6, Poppy row 7) and the packet's own defect flag.
audit.why: Rocket Grab is a projectile pull, not a dash, so Poppy's anti-dash W cannot stop it early; only after tank items and a whiffed hook does Poppy flip the lane, matching the 53.19% Poppy WR skewed by a strong late-game recovery.
audit.corrected: Side set to Blitzcrank for Levels 1-3, 4-5, 6, First item; Poppy for Two+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown numbers, just generic filler.
audit.why: Rocket Grab's cooldown (20/19/18/17/16s) is the actual punish window, and it's the number players need to time step-ups.
audit.corrected: Added Rocket Grab's per-rank cooldown and clarified R (Keeper's Verdict) is for peel, not engage, given Blitz's grab outranges it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions flagged: both sides carry displacement (R vs Power Fist E) where whoever lands first wins the trade; Blitz's shields (P Mana Barrier, R Static Field) absorb burst; Power Fist is an auto-reset burst tell.
audit.why: These are unmentioned mechanical facts that change all-in timing and were supplied by the missing-interactions data for this exact matchup.
audit.corrected: Folded into cooldowns/phase text: Power Fist's wind-up is the visual tell to disengage before the knockup lands, and R silence strips shields — force Mana Barrier or bank R before committing.

edits.before: Q the contacts — the hammer chunk is honest and the passive shield toss annoys.
edits.after: Rocket Grab is a pull, not a dash — your W can't stop it. Hug minions or eat a hook.

edits.before: W governs dashes already — their mobility kit just lost its lane privileges.
edits.after: Blitz has no dash for W to punish — the Q hook still threatens every step-up.

edits.before: Full kit: E the wall-adjacent and Q the pinned — the lane's geometry is a weapon.
edits.after: Full combo now, but so is his: land Q first and Power Fist plus R silence follow.

edits.before: Zone with W threat — engage supports pay a no-dash tax to play.
edits.after: A single hook still flips any trade, no matter how you farm.

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict online — the dive that survives everything still flies home.
edits.after: His grab out-ranges your R cast — hold it to peel the hooked ally, not to engage.

edits.before: First item: the pins chunk and the W deletes engage comps.
edits.after: He one-shots on a pick with no gold; block for your carry.

edits.before: Late Poppy un-dives: W their mobility, E their carry into walls, and R the unstoppable problem.
edits.after: Two-plus items you tank the hook: W and peel neuter his combo, whiffed Q gets E-stunned.

edits.before: Ahead, hammer the geometry: pin Blitzcrank's carry off every wall and veto the recovery engages.
edits.after: Ahead, hold W for his Rocket Grab and E his squishy carry into a wall the moment he whiffs Q.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Trade only after Rocket Grab whiffs or is on cooldown — a landed hook means his whole combo follows.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Walking up while Rocket Grab is live — a landed hook chains Power Fist and R silence for free.

edits.before: Blitzcrank wins by landing Rocket Grab, denying your pattern, and starting one clean chain and letting it pay the whole lane.
edits.after: Blitzcrank wins by landing Rocket Grab (20/19/18/17/16s CD), pulling you or your ADC into Power Fist and his R silence.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Steadfast Presence answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: 20/19/18/17/16s, a projectile pull your W can't cancel — dodge behind minions, not with W. - Power Fist resets his auto for a knockup burst window. - Your Keeper's Verdict is 140/120/100s — spend it to peel, not to engage.
